Uses a random skill or magic.

9.description:
Use wings or levitation to fly in world map.

13.description:
Use a skill from another party member, ad
reduced cost if primary or secondary.

Basic dex attack
Physical, one enemy.

Basic INT+STR attack
Physical, one enemy.

16.description:
Basic str dex attack
Physical, one enemy.

17.description:
Basic PSI attack
Physical, one enemy.

18.description:
Basic INT attack
Physical, one enemy.

19.description:
Basic CON attack
Physical, one enemy.

20.name: WIS Attack
20.description:
Basic WIS attack
Physical, one enemy.

32.name: Train Skill
32.description:
Sets aside a moment to drill a technique,
turning practice into progress.

33.name: Shout
33.description:
A bellow that drags every enemy's attention onto
the user.

34.name: Defensive Stance
34.description:
Weight drops low and the guard shuts. Rooted,
and harder to hurt.

35.name: Drunken Fist
35.description:
Staggering nonsense nobody can read. The whole
line loses track.

36.name: Chi Focus
36.description:
The user gathers chi and reads the opening
before it opens.

37.name: Water Flow Stance
37.description:
Weight moves like water. Blows slide off instead
of landing.

38.name: Sleeping Fist
38.description:
A soft palm to the temple. The whole line drifts
off standing.

39.name: Reversal Stance
39.description:
The user stops swinging and waits to answer the
next mistake.

40.name: Power Stance
40.description:
Feet planted, shoulders squared. Everything
after hits harder.

41.name: Crippling Strike
41.description:
A short kick to the knee. No blood, and the wind
goes out of them.

42.name: Willpower
42.description:
The mind refuses. Nothing settles on the user
for a while.
42.message1: %1 sets their mind against it all!

43.name: Clear Mind
43.description:
One breath, and the ringing in the user's own
head stops.

44.name: Peek-a-boo Stance
44.description:
Gloves up at the cheeks. Almost nothing gets
through to land.

45.name: Read Opponent
45.description:
The user watches one enemy until they know
exactly where to hit.

46.name: Ginga
46.description:
The endless capoeira sway. Never quite where the
blow arrives.

47.name: Siu Nim Tau
47.description:
The first wing chun form. Centre held, elbows
in, feet rooted.

48.name: Tai Chi Form
48.description:
Slow circles that turn force aside rather than
meeting it.

49.name: Systema Breathing
49.description:
Russian breathing. Pain and poison are simply
let go of.

50.name: Aikido Flow
50.description:
The user stops resisting and lets the attack
pass straight through.

51.name: Sumo Shiko
51.description:
The sumo stamp. Both feet down, and nothing
moves the user after.

52.name: Limit Release
52.description:
The user unlocks what the body refuses, and
burns chi paying for it.

53.name: Blinding Screen
53.description:
A handful of grit thrown wide. Nobody in front
sees clearly.

54.name: Muscle Guard
54.description:
The user tenses everything at once and blows
land on stone.

55.name: Dynamic Stretch
55.description:
A quick stretch between exchanges. The joints
come loose.

56.name: Stance Martial Arts
56.description:
The plain ready position every school teaches on
the first day.

57.name: Precision Drill
57.description:
Repetition until the hand goes exactly where it
is sent.

58.name: Breath Control
58.description:
Four counts in, four counts out, and the AP
comes back.

59.name: Combat Analysis
59.description:
The user reads one enemy's habits and stops
having to guess.

60.name: Over Break
60.description: Pushing past the point where the body says stop.

61.name: Core Martial Arts
61.description:
Everything worked from the middle out. Nothing
spectacular.

62.name: Vital Targeting
62.description:
The user marks where one enemy is thinnest and
leaves it open.

63.name: Defensive Drill
63.description:
An hour on the bag, cold. It shows later in the
round.

64.name: Energy Restoration
64.description:
The user finds their breath and some blood
pressure again.

65.name: Combat Readiness
65.description:
Shoulders down, hands up, weight even. Simply
ready for it.
65.message1: %1 enters a state of heightened focus!

66.name: Rapid Conditioning
66.description: A brutal warm-up crammed into a single exchange.

67.name: Defensive Conditioning
67.description:
Everything drilled toward the business of not
being hit.

68.name: Offensive Conditioning
68.description:
Everything drilled toward hitting first and
hitting hardest.

69.name: Battle Martial Arts
69.description:
The whole syllabus at once, held for as long as
it lasts.

70.name: Spiritual Martial Arts
70.description:
The half of the art that has nothing to do with
the fists.

71.name: Divine Communion
71.description:
The user asks for help and something quiet
answers and mends them.

72.name: Malicious Focus
72.description:
The user thinks about hurting somebody until it
sharpens them.

73.name: Blood Suck
73.description:
Teeth to one enemy's throat. What is taken is
kept.

74.name: Submission Hold
74.description:
The user takes an arm and sits on it until the
enemy is held.

75.name: Hurricane Kicks
75.description:
Kicks thrown in a circle until the whole line
has taken one.

76.name: Chair Shot
76.description:
Furniture, swung flat. It finds the guard before
the body.

77.name: Combination Strike
77.description:
Four textbook punches thrown as one long
unbroken motion.

78.name: Lariat
78.description:
One arm across the whole line at neck height.
Nobody stays up.

79.name: DDT
79.description:
A head driven into the floor. Brief, final, and
stunning.

80.name: Top Rope Splash
80.description:
Off the top rope onto the whole line. They come
up floating.

81.name: Dropkick
81.description:
Both feet, chest height, straight through the
front rank.

82.name: Tai Chi Healing
82.description:
Slow circles until the user's own breathing does
the mending.

83.name: Focused Chi
83.description:
Chi gathered in the palm and pushed across into
one enemy.

84.name: Street Fighting
84.description:
No form at all. Whatever is left when the user
is losing badly.

85.name: Net and Trident
85.description:
Net first, trident second. One enemy stops going
anywhere.

86.name: Chi Healing
86.description:
The user circulates chi inward until the damage
recedes.

87.name: Punch Flurry
87.description:
Punches thrown faster than anybody present can
count them.

88.name: Eskrima Combo
88.description:
Filipino stickwork, both hands, and no pauses
anywhere in it.

89.name: Bagua Circle Walking
89.description:
The user walks the circle until one enemy faces
the wrong way.

90.name: Silat Combo
90.description:
Indonesian close work: elbows and knees,
delivered at speed.

91.name: Pressure Point
91.description:
A thumb into a nerve cluster. The arm stops
working entirely.

92.name: German Suplex Combo
92.description:
Three suplexes without letting go once in
between them.

93.name: Figure-Four Leg Lock
93.description:
The legs are folded into a shape legs do not
fold into.

94.name: Elbow Fury
94.description:
Elbows thrown short and repeatedly into the
exact same spot.

95.name: Powerbomb
95.description:
Lifted overhead and driven down. Nobody gets up
from it quickly.

96.name: Armbar
96.description:
The elbow is straightened past the point elbows
straighten to.

97.name: Reverse Bomb
97.description:
Picked up facing the wrong way and dropped hard
backward.

98.name: Leg Sweep
98.description:
A low kick that takes one enemy's standing leg
out from under.

99.name: Body Blows
99.description:
Nothing to the head. Everything to the ribs,
until the breath goes.

100.name: Taekwondo Kick Combo
100.description:
Four kicks above the belt without the foot
touching down twice.

101.name: Tsuki
101.description:
The karate straight punch, put through a guard
already broken.

102.name: Savate Combination
102.description:
French boxing footwork carried across the whole
front rank.

103.name: Sumo Tsuppari
103.description:
Open-hand slaps to the chest, over and over,
sumo fashion.

104.name: Eskrima Strike
104.description:
A rattan stick onto the forearm that is holding
the guard up.

105.name: Zen Meditation
105.description:
The user sits down in the middle of it all and
stops entirely.

106.name: Lightning Jab
106.description:
A jab so quick the enemy is still deciding when
it arrives.

107.name: Sok Trong
107.description:
The Vietnamese elbow, thrown upward into an
unguarded jaw.

108.name: Chain Punches
108.description:
Wing chun chain punching straight down the
centre line.

109.name: Krav Maga Counter
109.description:
The Israeli answer: whatever is nearest, into
whatever is open.

110.name: Tai Chi Push Hands
110.description:
Barely a push, and one enemy finds themselves
somewhere else.

111.name: Silat Sapuan
111.description:
A silat sweep that takes the whole line off
their feet at once.

112.name: Savate Chasse
112.description:
A long push kick that keeps one enemy at arm's
length and rocking.

113.name: Body Scissors
113.description:
Legs closed around the ribs and squeezed until
it counts.

114.name: Tae Chiang
114.description:
A short strike under the sternum and everything
empties out.

115.name: Baguazhang Palm
115.description:
The bagua palm, thrown out of a turn nobody saw
begin.

116.name: Systema Pressure Point
116.description:
A systema touch to the nerve, delivered almost
gently.

117.name: Sunset Flip
117.description:
The user rolls under and one enemy goes over
backward.

118.name: Dual Attack
118.description:
Both hands, one after the other, into the same
target.

119.name: Double Attack
119.description:
Two hits thrown at whichever enemy happens to be
in front.

120.name: Triple Attack
120.description:
Three hits scattered across whoever is standing
closest.

121.name: Bodyslam
121.description:
Picked up and dropped flat. Simple, and they
stay down stunned.

122.name: Rapid Fist
122.description:
Three straight punches inside the space of one
heartbeat.

123.name: Thunder Palm
123.description:
The palm arrives before the thunder that comes
with it does.

124.name: Rising Dragon Kick
124.description:
An upward kick that leaves one enemy briefly off
the ground.

125.name: Counter Stance
125.description:
The user gives up the initiative deliberately,
and answers.

126.name: Flying Knee
126.description:
A knee driven into somebody already off their
line.

127.name: Flame Fist
127.description:
The fist is already burning before it gets
there.

128.name: Frost Palm
128.description:
The palm leaves frost on whatever part of them
it touches.

129.name: Bi-strike
129.description:
Two strikes from two angles, arriving at the
same moment.

130.name: Lightning Strike
130.description:
The user moves first and marks one enemy for
what comes next.

131.name: Sweep
131.description:
A low arc across the whole line at ankle height.
Down they go.

132.name: Spinning Hook Kick
132.description:
A heel that comes round from behind and finds a
temple.

133.name: Kao Loi
133.description:
The muay thai knee, thrown from inside a clinch
they cannot leave.

134.name: Chi Sao
134.description:
Sticking hands. The user feels the attack before
seeing it.

135.name: Krav Maga Burst
135.description:
Everything at once at everyone, with no regard
for form or guard.

136.name: Five Animals Fist
136.description:
Tiger, crane, leopard, snake and dragon in one
exchange.

137.name: Eskrima Disarm
137.description:
A twist at the wrist. Whatever was held is no
longer held.

138.name: Silat Joint Attack
138.description:
Silat joint work. The limb is taken, and it is
not given back.

139.name: Stunner
139.description:
The jaw goes onto the shoulder on the way down.
Lights out.

140.name: Spirit Breaking Strike
140.description:
A strike aimed at whatever it is that holds a
person together.

141.name: Cyclone Strikes
141.description:
The user turns, and turns, and does not stop
turning.

142.name: Thousand Fists
142.description:
More punches than one exchange should be able to
contain.

143.name: Brass Knuckle Hook
143.description:
Metal on the knuckles, into a guard that was
already open.

144.name: Crowd's Favor
144.description:
The crowd roars for the man who is losing, and
he answers.

145.name: Mae Geri
145.description:
The front kick. First thing taught, and it still
puts them down.

146.name: Ippon Seoi Nage
146.description:
The shoulder throw. One enemy goes over the back
and stays down.
146.message1: %1 executes a perfect Ippon Seoi Nage!

147.name: Systema Flow
147.description:
Constant motion, never braced, never quite where
the blow lands.

148.name: Savate Fouette
148.description:
The savate roundhouse, thrown with the shin
turned right over.

149.name: Flying Forearm Smash
149.description:
The user leaves the ground and arrives forearm
first.

150.name: Armada
150.description:
A capoeira spin kick that reaches every enemy in
the line.

151.name: Sambo Throw
151.description:
Sambo. Grip, hip, floor, roughly in that order,
and they stay there.

152.name: Uki Goshi
152.description:
The floating hip throw, with almost no effort
visible in it.

153.name: Aikido Throw
153.description:
The enemy's own force, politely redirected into
the floor.

154.name: Flying Elbow Drop
154.description:
Elbow first, from height, onto somebody still
coming down.

155.name: Sharpshooter
155.description:
Both legs crossed and turned over. Nobody
escapes this one.

156.name: T-Bone Suplex
156.description:
A belly-to-belly throw that finishes behind the
user.

157.name: Lineage Crusher
157.description:
A blow saved for the wounded, and wasted on
anybody else.

158.name: Meditate
158.description:
The user shuts their eyes in the middle of a
fight and mends.

159.name: Guard Breaker
159.description:
A strike thrown at the guard itself until the
guard comes apart.

160.name: Vital Point Strike
160.description:
One finger, one point, and something important
stops working.

161.name: Karate Chop
161.description:
The edge of the hand into the side of the neck.
Nothing moves after.

162.name: Precision Strike
162.description:
A blow placed exactly where the last one left
them open.

163.name: Capoeira Roda
163.description:
The user enters the roda and the game begins in
earnest.

164.name: Sambo Joint Lock
164.description:
The sambo lock. Simple, and there is no arguing
with it.

165.name: Osoto Gari
165.description:
The great outer reap. The leg goes while they
are still leaning.

166.name: Aikido Joint Lock
166.description:
The wrist is turned until the whole arm stops
answering.

167.name: Spinebuster
167.description:
Lifted at the waist and driven back down spine
first.

168.name: Arcane Armor
168.description:
Borrowed sorcery hardens the user's skin for a
while.

169.name: Frog Splash
169.description:
Off the top rope, flat, onto somebody who cannot
roll away.

170.name: Plum Khao
170.description:
Knees from the clinch, and the clinch does not
open for them.

171.name: Power Slam
171.description:
Carried a short distance and put through the
floor.

172.name: Mood Swing
172.description:
Whatever the user has been holding in comes out
right here.

173.name: Dynasty Driver
173.description:
A driver that finishes with nobody left standing
up.

174.name: Suplex
174.description:
Bridge backward, and the mat handles the rest of
it.

175.name: Tornado Kick
175.description:
A jumping turn kick that reaches everyone
standing in front.

176.name: One-Inch Punch
176.description:
The fist travels almost no distance and empties
them anyway.

177.name: Strong Attack
177.description:
Nothing clever. Thrown hard, at the guard, until
it gives.

178.name: Roundhouse Kick
178.description:
The shin comes round into the ribs of somebody
off balance.

179.name: Circular kick
179.description:
A wide arcing kick that catches the whole rank
across the head.

180.name: Knockout Uppercut
180.description:
Up through the chin, and the lights go out for a
moment.

181.name: Axe Kick
181.description:
The heel comes down from above onto the
collarbone.

182.name: Seiken
182.description:
The proper fist, thrown properly, at exactly the
proper place.

183.name: High-Flying Dive
183.description:
The user leaves the ropes and lands on the
entire line.

184.name: Sumo Yorikiri
184.description:
The enemy is walked backward out of the ring and
then further.

185.name: Death Touch
185.description:
A touch that does nothing visible until it does
everything.

186.name: Dragon Ascending
186.description:
Chi rises up through the user and leaves through
the fist.

187.name: Barroom Blitz
187.description:
Bottles, stools, and no rules of any kind
whatsoever.

188.name: Bloody Execution
188.description:
The wounded are finished messily, and they bleed
the whole way.

189.name: Skull-Crushing Finale
189.description:
The last thing a losing opponent hears before
the ringing.

190.name: Wrestling Finisher
190.description:
Whatever the user's finishing move happens to
be, tonight.

191.name: Haymaker
191.description:
Wound up from the hip and thrown at everything
at once.

192.name: Krav Maga Strike
192.description:
Efficient, ugly, and aimed at a guard that is
already broken.

193.name: Ultimate Combo
193.description:
Every technique the user knows, spent in a
single exchange.

194.name: Berserk Frenzy
194.description:
The user stops thinking altogether and simply
keeps hitting.

195.name: Piledriver
195.description:
Head down, straight into the mat, and it stays
down there.

196.name: Dragon Fist
196.description:
The fist arrives shaped like something with
teeth in it.

197.name: Spirit Cannon
197.description:
Everything the user has, fired out through both
palms at once.

198.name: Champion's Combination
198.description:
The combination that won somebody a belt, a long
time ago.

199.name: Grand Master's Secret
199.description:
The technique the master only ever demonstrated
once.

200.name: Asura's Wrath
200.description:
Six arms would not be enough for what happens to
them here.

201.name: Undisputed Champion
201.description:
The title defence, performed on somebody who is
not champion.

202.name: Champion of the Arena
202.description:
The sand remembers this one, and so does the
whole crowd.

203.name: Dragon Spirit Strike
203.description:
Something enormous moves through the user and
out the other side.

204.name: Qigong
204.description:
The user works the breath through every meridian
in turn.
204.message1: %1 works the breath through every meridian!

205.name: Ultimate Finisher
205.description:
The move the user saves for when the fight has
to end now.

206.name: Final Reckoning
206.description:
Every bill comes due at once, and somebody has
to pay it.

207.name: Galvanic Grip
207.description:
The user's grip carries a current that has no
business existing.

208.name: Life-Binding Strike
208.description:
The wound binds the two of them, and only one of
them gains.

209.name: Tumbling Evasion
209.description:
The user hits the floor deliberately and comes
up somewhere else.

210.name: Mantra of Peace
210.description:
Words repeated until nothing at all can take
hold of the user.

211.name: Jab Combo
211.description:
Three jabs, thrown mostly to keep somebody
honest.

212.name: Final Paradise
212.description:
For one moment there is no fight and no pain
anywhere at all.

213.name: Tiger Dance
213.description:
The form is beautiful. Everyone standing in
front of it is not.

214.name: Aerial Assault
214.description:
The user comes down on somebody who is still up
in the air.

215.name: Chakra Strike
215.description:
A palm laid on a point that is not entirely
physical.

216.name: Liver Blow
216.description:
Under the ribs, on the right. Nobody keeps their
lunch down.

217.name: Mystic Onslaught
217.description:
Borrowed magic, thrown badly but very hard, at
everyone.

218.name: War Magic Mastery
218.description:
A fighter who learned spellcraft late and uses
it bluntly.

219.name: Acrobatic Flurry
219.description:
Four strikes thrown while barely touching the
ground at all.

220.name: Furious Flurry
220.description:
Four punches thrown considerably angrier than
they are accurate.

221.name: Dempsey Roll
221.description:
The weave and the hook, over and over, always
from below.

222.name: Death-Defying Leap
222.description:
The user jumps at somebody they had no business
reaching.

223.name: Nirvana Reach
223.description:
The user touches something very quiet and comes
back mended.

224.name: KO Punch
224.description:
One punch. Whoever was standing a moment ago is
not.

236.name: Protect
236.description:
Automatically protects allies with low HP for 1
turn.

237.name: Strike Flurry
237.description: Cuts thrown faster than the wrist should allow.

238.name: Knight's Resolve
238.description:
The knight remembers what they swore and stands
straighter.

239.name: Iaijutsu
239.description:
The blade is drawn and sheathed. The cut happens
in between.

240.name: Precision Thrust
240.description: The point goes exactly where it was sent.

241.name: Pommel Strike
241.description:
A heavy blow with the pommel or hilt of a
weapon, potentially stunning the target.

242.name: Circular Slash
242.description:
A full circle of edge, finishing where the guard
was open.

243.name: Weak Point Strike
243.description:
A precise strike targeting a weak point in the
enemy's COSs.

244.name: Swift Strike
244.description:
Out and back before the enemy has settled their
weight.

245.name: Cross Slash
245.description:
A series of cuts that form an X pattern on the
target.

246.name: Wide Swing
246.description:
A broad, unsubtle sweep with the whole arm
behind it.

247.name: Laceration Strike
247.description:
A brutal attack that can cause bleeding damage
over time.

248.name: Guard Strike
248.description:
A powerful blow using the guard or hilt to
strike at close range.

249.name: Slash
249.description:
The plainest cut there is, waiting for an
opening.

250.name: Windmill
250.description:
The blade goes round twice and the user comes
with it.

251.name: Ground Sweep
251.description:
A slash that targets the legs to slow enemy
movement.

252.name: Opportunity Strike
252.description:
The user waits, and takes the moment when it
comes.

253.name: Wild Thrust
253.description:
Randomly performs 4 attacks on 4 enemies.
Physical, three random enemies.

254.name: Whirlwind Slash
254.description:
A spinning cut aimed at somebody already
reeling.

255.name: Flat Strike
255.description:
A crushing blow with the flat side of a weapon,
potentially causing stunning.

256.name: Rapid Thrust
256.description:
Thrusts delivered from the elbow, one after
another.

257.name: Phalanx Formation
257.description: Shields overlapped and the line closes up.

258.name: Falcon Thrust
258.description: A thrust that drops on the target from above.

259.name: Double Thrust
259.description:
Performs an attack on an enemy twice.
Physical, one enemy. x2

260.name: Overhead Smash
260.description:
A powerful downward strike with full force
behind it.

261.name: Diagonal Slash
261.description:
A powerful diagonal slash that's difficult to
block.

262.name: Crescent Moon Slash
262.description: One long curved cut across the whole enemy line.

263.name: Ground Slam
263.description:
A crushing blow that slams the enemy to the
ground.

264.name: Enchanted Blade
264.description: The blade is spoken to before it is swung.

265.name: Laser Eye
265.description:
Something focused and unpleasant comes out of
the eye.

266.name: Uppercut Strike
266.description:
A powerful upward strike that can break through
COS

267.name: Excalibur Thrust
267.description:
A thrust with rather more history behind it than
usual.

268.name: Spin Crash
268.description:
The user spins into the middle of them and keeps
spinning.

269.name: Power Lunge
269.description: The whole body committed behind a single point.

270.name: Spirit of the Bushido
270.description:
The user remembers the code and fights better
for it.

271.name: Kingdom's Shield
271.description:
A shield raised over more people than it should
cover.

272.name: Armor Piercer
272.description:
Inflicts damage on all enemies regardless of
COS.

273.name: Master's Technique
273.description:
The technique the user has practised more than
any other.

274.name: Steelcleaver
274.description:
Enough steel and enough weight to go through the
guard.

275.name: Maiden’s Stance
275.description:
Performs a super powerful attack on an enemy.
Physical, one enemy.

276.name: Limit Surge
276.description: The user goes past what the body was rated for.

277.name: Spellstrike
277.description:
The spell is cast along the edge and lands with
it.

278.name: Rocket Punch
278.description:
The arm detaches, travels, and is retrieved
afterwards.

279.name: Hyperslash
279.description:
More cuts than one motion should be able to
contain.

280.name: Shield Bash
280.description:
The flat of the shield into the front of the
guard.

281.name: Provoke
281.description:
The user makes themselves the most irritating

The whole armory: every staple item, weapon and
reagent.

ASCII reality, the fog lifted, the terminal
bared.

1665.description: Mark this place as open sky.

Endless blizzard and killing cold under broken
heaven.

1669.name: HeatwaveHavoc

1697.description: Leap the Road by quantum teleportation.

1698.description: Step instantly to your nearest vehicle.

1700.name: Dream Door
1700.message1: %1 slips away through a dream door!

1705.name: Pool Play
1705.description: Rack up a game of pool.
1705.message1: %1 racks up a game of pool!

1707.name: Lock Lark
1707.description: Pick a lock through the tumbling rite.

1708.name: Key Kaprice
1708.description: Sit and play the visual piano.

1711.name: Carnival Chaos
1711.description:
Throw open the slots, the races and the pool
table at once.

1712.name: Fireball
1712.description:
The standard sphere of fire, and one enemy left
burning.

1713.name: Firestorm
1713.description:
Fire that stops being a spell and becomes
weather over the line.

1714.name: EmberDart
1714.description:
One ember flicked into a collar. It catches and
stays lit.

1715.name: IceShard
1715.description:
A shard of ice broken off something larger and
thrown hard.

1716.name: Blizzard
1716.description:
Snow arrives horizontally on the line and does
not let up.

1717.name: FrostBite
1717.description:
Cold worked into the extremities until they stop
reporting back.

1718.name: SparkBolt
1718.description:
A bolt no thicker than a finger, and no slower.
It leaves a charge.

1719.name: ThunderCrash
1719.description:
The noise reaches the line before the lightning
does.

1720.name: ChainSpark
1720.description:
The charge jumps from one enemy onward and
sticks to them.

1721.name: WaterJet
1721.description:
Water at a pressure that cuts rather than soaks.
It still soaks.

1722.name: TidalWave
1722.description:
One wave over the whole line, from wherever the
caster looks.

1723.name: Bubble
1723.description:
A bubble placed over a face. They are wet and
short of air.

1724.name: WindSlash
1724.description:
A blade of moving air, thin enough that nobody
sees it coming.

1725.name: Cyclone
1725.description:
The air turns in a circle and lifts the whole
line off the floor.

1726.name: GustPush
1726.description:
A shove made entirely of wind. One enemy leaves
the ground.

1727.name: RockThrow
1727.description:
A rock picked up and used as rocks are used.
Leaves petro slick.

1728.name: Earthquake
1728.description:
The ground shakes hard enough that the whole
line slips.

1729.name: GravelSpray
1729.description:
Grit into the eyes of somebody already
struggling to see.

1730.name: HolyRay
1730.description:
A ray of sacred light through somebody already
opened.

1731.name: Judgment
1731.description:
Sentence passed on the whole line, and carried
out.

1732.name: Smite
1732.description: Struck from above, once, with no discussion.

1733.name: ShadowBolt
1733.description:
A bolt of dark aimed at somebody already
reeling.

1734.name: Doom
1734.description:
A word of ending laid over the entire enemy
line.

1735.name: DrainTouch
1735.description:
A hand laid on one enemy that takes rather than
gives.

1736.name: HealLight
1736.description:
A small light held over one ally until they
mend.

1737.name: Regenerate
1737.description: Growth set running in one ally and left to work.

1738.name: GroupMend
1738.description: One mending stretched across the whole party.

1739.name: StarLance
1739.description:
A lance of starlight for somebody already broken
open.

1740.name: MeteorShower
1740.description:
Small burning things in quantity, all over the
enemy line.

1741.name: ArcanePulse
1741.description:
A pulse of raw arcana through the entire enemy
line.

1742.name: SoulFlare
1742.description: A soul goes up like a flare over the enemy line.

1743.name: VoidRipple
1743.description:
A ripple in the void, and one enemy comes out
wet.

1744.name: MagmaGeyser
1744.description:
A hole opens under one enemy and something
molten rises.

1745.name: FlameWheel
1745.description:
A burning wheel rolled through the line.
Everyone catches.

1746.name: Backdraft
1746.description:
The fire pulls back, then returns all at once
and hotter.

1747.name: HailStorm
1747.description:
Fist-sized ice from a clear sky onto the whole
enemy line.

1748.name: GlacialSpike
1748.description:
A spike driven up through somebody the cold
already slowed.

1749.name: FrostBloom
1749.description:
Frost that opens outward like a flower and does
not close.

1750.name: PlasmaArc
1750.description:
An arc bright enough to leave an afterimage and
a charge.

1751.name: TeslaField
1751.description:
The whole area is put under charge and nobody is
let out of it.

1752.name: ArcSurge
1752.description:
The current climbs rather than travels, and the
line climbs with it.

1753.name: Whirlpool
1753.description:
The water turns and the whole line goes round
and under with it.

1754.name: DelugeWave
1754.description:
Rather more water than anyone expected, over all
of them.

1755.name: MistVeil
1755.description:
A wet fog that clings to one enemy and will not
clear.

1756.name: SandBlast
1756.description:
Sand at speed into the gaps in the armour. It
leaves them slick.

1757.name: StoneEdge
1757.description:
Stone driven up under an enemy who has already
stopped moving.

1758.name: GroundTremor
1758.description:
A low rumble across the line. Everyone ends up
slipping in petro.

1759.name: ThornWhip
1759.description:
A thorned vine thrown like a whip. It carries
one enemy up.

1760.name: PollenBurst
1760.description:
Pollen in quantities nobody agreed to. The line
drifts upward.

1761.name: LeafGale
1761.description:
Leaves moving fast enough to cut, all across the
enemy line.

1762.name: PrismBeam
1762.description:
Light split and turned on a line already
faltering.

1763.name: DawnBreak
1763.description:
The sun comes up in one enemy's face, guard and
all.

1764.name: HolyNova
1764.description: Sacred light released at once over every enemy.

1765.name: NightmareVeil
1765.description:
A dream pulled over one enemy that will not
lift.

1766.name: VoidLance
1766.description:
A lance of nothing for somebody already opened
up.

1767.name: EclipseRay
1767.description:
A ray from behind the moon, across a faltering
line.

1768.name: AcidSpit
1768.description: Something corrosive spat into one enemy's face.

1769.name: VenomCloud
1769.description:
Venom hung in the air over the entire enemy
line.

1770.name: PlagueMist
1770.description: Sickness laid over the line like weather.

1771.name: MindBlast
1771.description: One enemy's mind is struck as if it were a body.

1772.name: PsiWave
1772.description: A wave of thought across the whole enemy line.

1773.name: Hypnoshock
1773.description:
One enemy is put under and shocked in the same
motion.

1774.name: EchoBurst
1774.description: A sound that arrives twice, over the enemy line.

1775.name: SonicLance
1775.description:
A spear of sound for somebody already
staggering.

1776.name: CometFall
1776.description: Something falls from very far up onto the line.

1777.name: GravityWell
1777.description:
Weight where there was none, under the whole
line.

1778.name: NebulaBurst
1778.description:
A cloud of new stars, opened over the enemy
line.

1779.name: StardustHeal
1779.description:
Something falls on the party like dust and mends
them.

1780.name: CleansingRain
1780.description: Rain that takes the dirt and the wounds with it.

1781.name: MendingBloom
1781.description:
Something grows over one ally and closes the
wound.

1782.name: Power Strike
1782.description:
A blow with the shoulder behind it and nothing
else.

1783.name: Heavy Blow
1783.description: Slow, telegraphed, and it does not matter.

1784.name: Quick Jab
1784.description: The shortest punch there is, and the fastest.

1785.name: Uppercut
1785.description: Up from below, into a chin already lifted.

1786.name: Roundhouse Kick
1786.description:
The leg comes round from outside the field of
view.

1787.name: Crushing Blow
1787.description: Enough force to matter more than where it lands.

1788.name: Double Slash
1788.description:
Two cuts on the same line, the second one
deeper.

1789.name: Headbutt
1789.description: Forehead to nose. Nobody enjoys this one.

1790.name: Stomp
1790.description:
The heel comes down on something already on the
floor.

1791.name: Pommel Strike
1791.description: The wrong end of the sword, used deliberately.

1792.name: Body Check
1792.description:
The user's whole weight, arriving shoulder
first.

1793.name: Spin Kick
1793.description:
The user turns all the way round and the foot
follows.

1794.name: ThrowingKnife
1794.description: A blade balanced for leaving the hand.

1795.name: Shuriken
1795.description: Small, sharp, and thrown without a wind-up.

1796.name: Arrow Shot
1796.description:
Loosed at a distance nobody thought was in
range.

1797.name: Slingshot
1797.description:
A stone, a strap, and rather more velocity than
expected.

1798.name: Crossbow Bolt
1798.description:
Punches through whatever the target thought was
protecting them.

1799.name: Bite
1799.description: Jaws closed on the nearest limb.

1800.name: Scratch
1800.description: Four lines opened where there was skin.

1801.name: Tail Whip
1801.description:
The tail is heavier than it looks and moves
faster.

1802.name: Gore
1802.description: Horns, lowered, and then a short run.

1803.name: Peck
1803.description: A beak into the same spot until it gives.

1804.name: Sting
1804.description: A sting delivered and then withdrawn quickly.

1805.name: FireSpark
1805.description:
A spark struck off nothing and dropped down one
enemy's collar.

1806.name: FrostNeedle
1806.description:
A needle of ice, thin and quick, and the cold
stays behind.

1807.name: ShockJolt
1807.description:
A jolt through whatever one enemy is holding. It
keeps buzzing.

1808.name: WaterSpurt
1808.description:
A short jet of water straight into one enemy's
face.

1809.name: WindCut
1809.description:
A thin cut opened in one enemy by nothing but
moving air.

1810.name: RockChip
1810.description:
A chip of stone flicked fast. It leaves a petro
smear behind.

1811.name: LightMote
1811.description:
A mote of light dropped in front of one enemy's
eyes.

1812.name: ShadowNeedle
1812.description: A needle of shadow slid into one enemy's guard.

1813.name: EmberFlick
1813.description:
One ember flicked with a fingernail. Small, and
it catches.

1814.name: IceChip
1814.description:
A chip of ice, small and unpleasant, and the
chill stays.

1815.name: StaticNip
1815.description:
A nip of static where one enemy's skin is
thinnest.

1816.name: DustPuff
1816.description:
A puff of dust into the eyes and lungs. It
leaves them slick.

1817.name: War Cry
1817.description: The user shouts, and finds they meant it.

1818.name: Focus
1818.description:
The user stops doing everything else for a
moment.

1819.name: Intimidate
1819.description: The user makes the whole line reconsider.

1820.name: Rally
1820.description: The party is called back together and answers.

1821.name: SteamBurst
1821.description:
Water hits something hot over the whole enemy
line.

1822.name: Frostfire
1822.description:
Fire and ice held in the same hand, given to one
enemy.

1823.name: Stormfront
1823.description:
The front arrives, and the enemy line is inside
it.

1824.name: MagmaEruption
1824.description:
The ground opens and the enemy line stands over
it.

1825.name: ThunderTide
1825.description: Charged water rolls over the entire line.

1826.name: IceStorm
1826.description: Ice arrives horizontally across the whole line.

1827.name: HolyFlame
1827.description: Fire that burns clean, put into one enemy.

1828.name: ShadowFrost
1828.description: Cold and dark together, worked into one enemy.

1829.name: VenomSpark
1829.description:
A spark carrying something that should not
conduct.

1830.name: Tempest
1830.description: Weather with intent, turned on the enemy line.

1831.name: Cataclysm
1831.description: Everything the caster can break, broken at once.

1832.name: Prismstorm
1832.description: Light shattered into colour over the whole line.

1833.name: AuroraStorm
1833.description: The sky turns the wrong colours above the enemy.

1834.name: Purgatory
1834.description: A place for waiting, opened around one enemy.

1835.name: Abyss
1835.description: Something deep looks up at one enemy.

1836.name: StaticBloom
1836.description: Charge blooms outward across the entire line.

1837.name: GritGale
1837.description: Sand on a hard wind, over every enemy standing.

1838.name: RadiantTide
1838.description:
A tide of light that lifts and soaks the enemy
line.

1839.name: VortexCollapse
1839.description:
A vortex opens on the line and finishes what is
already falling.

1840.name: InfernalCataclysm
1840.description:
Fire from somewhere lower down, over the entire
line.

1841.name: StormColumn
1841.description:
A column of lightning standing in the middle of
the enemy.

1842.name: AbyssalMaw
1842.description: Something with a mouth opens beneath the line.

1843.name: RadiantCross
1843.description:
A cross of light nailed through one enemy. It
blinds.

1844.name: FrostLance
1844.description:
A lance of ice for somebody the cold has already
found.

1845.name: TempestEdge
1845.description:
A wind edge across a line that is already
staggering.

1846.name: VoidPillar
1846.description: A pillar of nothing rises and works on the line.

1847.name: PlagueBloom
1847.description:
Sickness opens like a flower over the whole
enemy line.

1848.name: PrismMaelstrom
1848.description:
Light broken into every colour, over everyone,
all at once.

1849.name: ElementalChaos
1849.description:
Every element at cross purposes across the enemy
line.

1850.name: StarfallNova
1850.description:
A star falls in the middle of them and the noise
stops.

1851.name: ThunderRing
1851.description:
A ring of lightning closes around the entire
line.

1852.name: EmberVortex
1852.description:
Embers turning fast enough to strip the enemy
line.

1853.name: HolyLance
1853.description:
A lance of sacred light for somebody already
opened up.

1854.name: CrystalQuake
1854.description:
Crystal comes up through the floor under all of
them.

1855.name: WindScythe
1855.description:
A scythe of wind through a line that is already
reeling.

1856.name: EldritchGaze
1856.description:
Something looks back at the whole line and marks
them.

1857.name: RainbowRupture
1857.description: Colour comes apart wetly over the enemy line.

1858.name: CellularBloom
1858.description:
Cells divide where cells should not, across the
line.

1859.name: OccultMoon
1859.description: A moon nobody charted rises over the enemy.

1860.name: HeartStorm
1860.description: Something beats in the air above the whole line.

1861.name: SporeHive
1861.description:
Spores take hold and the hive gets to work on
them.

1862.name: StarChoir
1862.description:
Stars sing over the enemy line, and it is not
pleasant.

1863.name: ClockworkVortex
1863.description: Gears turn in the air where no gears are.

1864.name: PhotonCathedral
1864.description: Light builds a building over the enemy line.

1865.name: PlagueMiasma
1865.description: Old sickness settled over every enemy at once.

1866.name: HexOverload
1866.description: More hexes than the enemy line can carry.

1867.name: DreamStatic
1867.description:
The dream will not resolve, and the line freezes
in it.

1868.name: BloodmoonRite
1868.description:
A rite performed under the wrong moon, over
everyone.

1869.name: TeslaOrb
1869.description: A ball of charge left to wander the enemy line.

1870.name: FireballBurst
1870.description: A fireball let go early, over the whole line.

1871.name: FirestormSurge
1871.description:
The firestorm arrives before anybody smells
smoke.

1872.name: MeteorImpact
1872.description:
Something lands, and the enemy line is the
crater.

1873.name: FlameNovaRing
1873.description: A ring of fire opening outward through the line.

1874.name: MagmaUpheaval
1874.description:
The ground under the enemy line turns liquid and
hot.

1875.name: InfernoVortex
1875.description:
Fire turning fast enough to pull the line into
it.

1876.name: CinderShower
1876.description: Cinders falling steadily over every enemy.

1877.name: SolarFlareburst
1877.description: The sun sends something small and unbearable.

1878.name: AzureInferno
1878.description:
Fire burning at the wrong colour, over the enemy
line.

1879.name: FlashfireNova
1879.description: Everything ignites at once and then goes out.

1880.name: PyrePillar
1880.description:
A column of fire raised in the middle of the
line.

1881.name: FlameCyclone
1881.description:
Fire given a direction to turn, through the
enemy.

1882.name: Conflagration
1882.description: It stops being a fire and becomes a condition.

1883.name: BackdraftBurst
1883.description:
The fire draws breath and then takes the whole
line.

1884.name: FlameCurtain
1884.description: A hanging sheet of fire drawn across the enemy.

1885.name: HellfireRain
1885.description:
Fire falls steadily on the line and does not
stop.

1886.name: WitchfireHex
1886.description:
A hex that burns rather than curses, over
everyone.

1887.name: PhoenixFlare
1887.description: Something ends in fire so it can begin again.

1888.name: GravitonWell
1888.description:
A well of gravity opens and the enemy line leans
into it.

1889.name: CollapsarPull
1889.description:
Something collapsed and very hungry pulls at all
of them.

1890.name: EventCollapse
1890.description:
The event itself gives way under the entire
enemy line.

1891.name: ResonanceBloom
1891.description: A note held until the line comes off the floor.

1892.name: SonicRupture
1892.description: Sound past the point where sound stays sound.

1893.name: EchoNova
1893.description: An echo that arrives before its own sound does.

1894.name: RiftGate
1894.description:
A rift opens and something reaches through it
repeatedly.

1895.name: SummonPillar
1895.description:
A pillar is called up and set about the enemy
line.

1896.name: AbyssPortal
1896.description: A hole into somewhere worse, aimed at the line.

1897.name: ChronoWarp
1897.description:
Time is bent across the line and their voices
go.

1898.name: TimeFracture
1898.description:
A crack in the hour itself, opened over the
enemy.

1899.name: AeonPulse
1899.description:
One pulse of an age, and the line has nothing to
say.

1900.name: ConvokeDemon
1900.description: Open a way for a demon and pay for it in blood.
1900.message1: %1 opens a way for a demon and pays in blood!

1901.name: ConvokeUndead
1901.description: Raise a dead thing and hold it up with your own blood.
1901.message1: %1 raises a dead thing on their own blood!

1902.name: ConvokeElemental
1902.description: Bind an elemental to the line for as long as your mana lasts.
1902.message1: %1 binds an elemental to the line!

1903.name: ConvokeCelestial
1903.description: Call something down that answers only to a great deal of mana.
1903.message1: %1 calls something down from on high!

1904.name: ConvokeAutomaton
1904.description: Start an automaton. It runs on money, and keeps running on money.
1904.message1: %1 starts an automaton running on coin!

1905.name: ConvokeWarMachine
1905.description: Field a war machine at a ruinous hourly rate.

1906.name: ConvokeMenagerie
1906.description: The leash comes off: your pet fights, or the wild sends something.

1907.name: ConvokeSwarm
1907.description: Vermin answer, and feed on you while they work.
1907.message1: %1 calls vermin that feed while they work!

1908.name: ConvokeTide
1908.description: Something comes up out of the water and stays while the mana holds.
1908.message1: %1 calls something up out of the water!

1909.name: ConvokeWing
1909.description: Call something winged down onto the line.
1909.message1: %1 calls something winged down to the line!

1911.name: ConvokeVerdure
1911.description: Root a growing thing on the field. It asks nothing and cannot stay.
1911.message1: %1 roots a growing thing on the field!

1912.name: ConvokeFae
1912.description: Strike a bargain with the small folk, at the usual rate.
1912.message1: %1 strikes a bargain with the small folk!

1913.name: ConvokeShade
1913.description: A shade answers, held up by the SOUL shares it burns.
1913.message1: %1 holds a shade up on burning SOUL!

1914.name: ConvokeUmbra
1914.description: The shadows around the line resolve into something with teeth.
1914.message1: %1 lets the shadows resolve into teeth!

1915.name: ConvokeVoid
1915.description: Hold a way open for something from outside, at great cost.
1915.message1: %1 holds a way open to the outside!

1916.name: ConvokeWyrm
1916.description: Buy a wyrm's attention. The tribute is paid every turn.

1917.name: ConvokeTitan
1917.description: Wake something enormous. It leans on you the whole time.

1918.name: ConvokeChampion
1918.description: Hire an armed champion by the turn.

1919.name: ConvokeRabble
1919.description: Buy the help of whatever is loitering nearby. Cheap.
1919.message1: %1 buys the help of the nearest rabble!

1920.name: ConvokeMimic
1920.description: Call something that eats money, and keep feeding it.

1921.name: ConvokePetrodemon
1921.description: Burn the party's OIL to hold a petrodemon. It is not balanced. It is bought.
1921.message1: %1 burns OIL to hold a petrodemon!

1922.name: ConvokeElder
1922.description: Ask something very old to attend. It attends, and it drinks you dry.
1922.message1: %1 asks something very old to attend!

1923.name: ConvokeMarked
1923.description: Call the creature you marked, wherever you marked it.

1924.name: ConvokeSlain
1924.description: Call back the last thing the party killed, and pay for it in blood.
1924.message1: %1 calls back the last thing the party killed!

1925.name: ConvokeWitness
1925.description: Call a marked person to the field. They stay a few turns.
1925.message1: %1 calls a marked witness to the field!

1926.name: ConvokeReflection
1926.description: A lesser copy of you, paid for out of your own AP.
1926.message1: %1 pays out a lesser copy of themselves!

1927.name: ConvokeRevenant
1927.description: Call back a traveller the party has lost.

1928.name: MarkQuarry
1928.description: Mark a creature so a rite can find it later.

1929.name: MarkWitness
1929.description: Mark the person in front of you so a rite can call them.

1930.name: DismissSummon
1930.description: Send whatever you are holding on the field away.
